data.one_liner: Pure Dart library for parsing SVG path strings and generating Dart path code.
data.what_it_does: It parses SVG path data into a structured format and can generate Dart code that recreates the path. The library is independent of the Flutter runtime, making it suitable for pure Dart projects.
use_when: You need to parse SVG path data into a usable format.
You want to generate Dart code for SVG paths to embed in a Flutter or Dart app.
You are working on a tool that transforms or analyzes SVG paths.
You need a lightweight, pure-Dart solution without Flutter dependencies.
avoid_when: You require runtime rendering of SVG paths without parsing.
You need a full-featured SVG rendering engine.
You are building a Flutter widget that directly consumes SVG paths without code generation.
strengths: Supports code generation for Dart path constructors
Good test coverage and performance improvements
weaknesses: Limited to SVG path parsing only
Does not provide rendering or widget support
